---
title: "Variable dictionary"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE, message = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
library(owdata)
library(DT)

vr <- owd_variables()
```

The full cross-package variable dictionary: every documented variable in every catalogued and candidate openwashdata package, harvested from each package's `data-raw/dictionary.csv`. Use the search box to find every dataset in the organization that documents a given concept, for example "groundwater", "latrine" or "chlorine". The same search is available in R as `owd_search("groundwater")`.

## All variables

```{r}
datatable(
  data.frame(
    Package = vr$pkg_name,
    Dataset = vr$dataset_name,
    Variable = vr$variable_name,
    Type = vr$variable_type,
    Description = vr$description,
    check.names = FALSE
  ),
  rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
  options = list(pageLength = 25)
)
```
